name: First Ascent West Loop
research_notes: Former Brooklyn Boulders Chicago (West Loop); First Ascent operates it as of Feb 2026 (Devil's Lake guide). The official page (Wayback capture of 2026-09-28; the live site blocks the research machine's country) lists 100 S Morgan St, hours Mon-Fri 6am-11pm and Sat-Sun 10am-8pm, "roped climbing and bouldering", "100 unique boulders". The 2026-08-23 capture of the Chicago page says "First Ascent West Loop is now open". The old BKB Shopify store (wl.brooklynboulders.com) is unavailable. Pin: OSM building way tagged First Ascent at this address.

name: Crux Climbing Center Houston
research_notes: Crux's fourth gym, in The Plant (Second Ward); opened September 2026 with a grand-opening party on Sat 10 Oct 2026 (CultureMap). Official page 2026-10-13: "HOUSTON! WE ARE OPEN!", hours Mon-Fri 6am-10pm and Sat-Sun 10am-8pm, same amenities as Crux Central including bouldering. The 2026-06-25 Wayback capture of the home page still says "Houston location - coming soon". Pin: OSM building way carrying the 3100 Canal Street address (Nominatim); Photon did not return it.

name: MoCo Bouldering
research_notes: Bouldering gym in Conroe, about 40 miles north of Houston (grand opening 19 Jul 2025 per CBJ, 14 Jan 2026): 6,000 sq ft of walls, 80+ rotating boulder problems, Kilter board, group fitness. Site (copyright 2026) lists hours Mon/Wed/Fri 5am-10pm, Tue/Thu 9am-10pm, Sat 10am-10pm, Sun 10am-6pm, day pass $20, shoe and chalk rental. Pin: OSM building way carrying the 2004 North Frazier Street address (Nominatim).

name: Crux Climbing Center South Austin
research_notes: Crux's new South Austin gym opened 4 May 2026 (CBJ, 17 Jun 2026): 35,672 sq ft, 22,000 sq ft of wall with 48 ft rope walls, boulders, a competition bouldering wall moved from Pickle Road, Tension Board 2, Kilter and MoonBoard. It replaces the original Crux South gym at Pickle Road, which closed about 18 months earlier (existing record seed-141 -> retire follow-up). Crux's own South Austin page (live 2026-10-13, and the 8 Aug 2026 capture) gives the address and hours (Mon-Fri 6am-11pm, Sat-Sun 9am-10pm); the page text says "coming soon" only for a 2,000 sq ft tenant space next door. The site's own wording for bouldering at this particular gym is chain-level (home page title "Rock Climbing and Bouldering Gym", Crux Boulder League); the gym-specific bouldering statement is the CBJ profile. Pin: OSM building way carrying the 220 Ralph Ablanedo Drive address (the OSM postcode is 78715, the site says 78748).
